summary: The root LMM primarily means to collect, gather, or bring together. It can also refer to approaching or drawing near.

headwords.gloss: God rectified; repaired, and consolidated, what was disorganized, disordered; unsettled, of his affairs

parts.t: repaired, and consolidated, what was disorganized, disordered,

headwords.def: لَمَّ ٱللّٰهُ شَعَثَهُ God rectified, or repaired, and consolidated, what was disorganized, disordered, or unsettled, of his affairs. (S.)

headwords.gloss: He made a; of his hair
headwords.def: لَمَّمَ He made a لِمَّة of his hair. (Z, TA in art. جم .)

headwords.gloss: He came to the people, and alighted at their abode as a guest; He knew the meaning; He committed the sin

parts.t: He came to the people, and alighted at their abode as a guest.

headwords.def: أَلَمَّ بِالقَوْمِ He came to the people, and alighted at their abode as a guest. (Msb.) See أَطَافَ . And hence, أَلَمَّ بِالمَعْنَى (assumed tropical:) He knew the meaning. (Msb.) And أَلَمَّ بَالذَّنْبِ (assumed tropical:) He committed the sin, or offence. (Msb.) And أَلَمَّ He, or it, visited covertly; (Ham, p. 23;) or in a light, slight, or hasty manner. (Idem, pp. 385 and 815.) It became near. (Msb.) It happened. (Ham, p. 385.) أَلَمَّ بِهِ He came to him. (Ham, p. 127.) I. q. زَارَهُ غِبًّا ; as also أَلَمَّ عَلَيْهِ . (TA.)

headwords.gloss: It was collected, accumulated; They collected themselves; congregated
headwords.def: اِلْتَمَّ It was collected, accumulated. التمّوا They collected themselves; congregated.

headwords.def: لَمْ with an aor. following it is often to be rendered in English by the preterperfect: ex., لَمْ أَرَهُ مُذُ يَوْمَانِ I have not seen him for two days. لَمْ يَضْرِبْ He did not beat. (S, &c.) See also لَمَّا . أَلَمْ : see the latter half of art. أَلَا ; and the former part of art. أَمَا . لَمَّا as a particle of exception [is equivalent to our But; meaning both except and, after an oath or the like, only, or nothing more than; and] is put before a nominal proposition; as, إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ [ There is not any soul but over it is a guardian, (Kur lxxxvi. 4,)] accord. to those who pronounce the م with teshdeed: and before a verb which is literally, but not in meaning, a preterite; as in أَنْشُدُكَ ٱللّٰهَ لَمَّا

headwords.gloss: A slight insanity; diabolical possession; a slight taint
headwords.def: لَمَمٌ A slight insanity or diabolical possession; (Mgh, Msb:) a slight taint or infection of insanity. See طَيْفٌ .

headwords.gloss: A touch; somewhat; of a taint
headwords.def: لَمَّةٌ A touch, or somewhat [ of a taint or an infection of insanity ], from the jinn. (S, K.) See لَمَمٌ .

headwords.gloss: Hair that descends below the lobe of the ear

parts.t: Hair that descends below the lobe of the ear.
: and see a tropical use of it in a verse of Kumeyt cited in art.

headwords.def: لِمَّةٌ Hair that descends below the lobe of the ear. (S, K.) But see وَفْرَةٌ : and see a tropical use of it in a verse of Kumeyt cited in art. حف , p. 597 c.

headwords.gloss: A misfortune that befalls in the present world

parts.t: A misfortune that befalls in the present world.
(S.) See an ex. in a verse cited voce

headwords.def: مُلِمَّةٌ A misfortune that befalls in the present world. (S.) See an ex. in a verse cited voce حَجَا .
مُلَمَّمٌ A boy having a لِمَّة . (IDrd, TA, voce مُجَمَّمٌ .)

headword_note: Lane indexes geminate roots with two letters where the Corpus uses three; both spellings are resolved here.
